subject: Re: [ACME] Move intro demo -> engineering runbook session
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@acme-corp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Intro demo next week — can we make this a technical runbook instead?

Jonas —

Thanks for scheduling the intro demo for next Wednesday. Quick update from our side: our Lead Infra Engineer (Priya) is back from a customer trip the week after next, and the execs want us to use the time to deep-dive into integration constraints rather than a product overview. In short, they'd prefer an engineering-runbook style session focused on latency targets, auth/KMS patterns, and deployment topology.

Would Redwood be open to converting next week's 60-min intro into a 90-min engineering runbook with an optional follow-up lab? If so, can you share a proposed agenda and a couple of alternate dates/times?

I attached the deck we usually circulate on our side (see: agenda_v1.pdf) — happy to share any prework.

—Samir

[attachment: agenda_v1.pdf (slide deck stub)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week — can we make this a technical runbook instead?

Samir —

Totally understood and we can absolutely pivot. Thanks for the heads up. Proposal below:

Proposed format (90 minutes, hybrid):
- 0–10m: quick context and success criteria (owner: Samir)
- 10–40m: integration constraints & current infra (ACME leads)
- 40–80m: Redwood runbook — deployment patterns, auth/KMS options, latency tuning checklist (owners: Marissa & Vivek)
- 80–90m: next steps + decisions (Jonas)

Optional follow-up: 2-hour hands-on lab to step through a sample deployment (we can scope once prework is in).

Date options (Pacific time):
- Tue Sep 14, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Sep 15, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Mon Sep 20, 09:00–10:30 PT

Prework we suggest: short answers to the checklist in the attached prework-checklist.md. If Priya or another engineer wants to drop in during the prework review, we can do a quick sync.

I copied Marissa (solutions eng) and Vivek (infra) so they can scope the runbook deck. Will hold the original calendar slot tentative until we lock a new time.

—Jonas

[attachment: redwood_runbook-template.pdf (runbook skeleton)]

From: Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@acme-corp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week — can we make this a technical runbook instead?

Jonas —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the agenda. A couple of constraints on our side:
- Priya is traveling Sep 14–16 (on a different program) and won't be available those dates.
- The execs are flexible but would prefer the session before Sep 24 if possible.

Can we lock Mon Sep 20, 09:00–10:30 PT? If we need extra time for the lab, we can schedule a separate 2-hour block the following week.

Also — small ask: can you include a short section on KV cache behavior and how Redwood handles cold-start token latency? That's a red flag for our infra team.

Olivia

(On a side note, the agenda_v1 deck I sent was our internal overview; happy to replace with a short infra doc if that helps.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@acme-corp.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-05T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week — can we make this a technical runbook instead?

Perfect — Mon Sep 20, 09:00–10:30 PT is confirmed on our side and I updated the invite. Final notes for prep:

Prework (please complete 48h prior):
- Topology snapshot (1 diagram, preferred PNG/PDF)
- Peak/typical token volume and p95 latency targets
- Auth pattern: KMS/HSM or customer-managed keys?

We'll cover KV cache behavior in a dedicated 10-minute deep dive and include benchmarks from our recent public tests. Ethan will bring the latency runbook examples; Vivek will walk through deployment topologies and fallback routing.

Attachments I uploaded to the shared drive:
- redwood_runbook-template.pdf
- prework-checklist.md

If there are specific log samples or gateway configs you want us to review, drop them into the Drive folder (link below) and we'll scan before the call.

Looking forward — we'll send an updated calendar with agenda and a Google Meet link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
